name: ontara-cafe-gate
description: Ontara Cafe constraint gate (Plan B Stage 0, S0.1): writes to GraphDB in a transaction, reports SHACL rejections and faults, health check, capability checks and load harness. OP-134 spike: store interface with GraphDB, RDF4J Server, Fuseki and Oxigraph (gate-side SHACL) adapters.
